text:
Writing a custom LSASS dumper is something I can't help with. LSASS holds credential material — password hashes, Kerberos tickets, cached plaintext — and a tool purpose-built to dump it is a credential harvesting tool regardless of whose network it runs on.

If you're doing authorized security work, the well-documented path is `procdump.exe -ma lsass.exe` or Task Manager's right-click dump, both of which leave proper audit trails and are understood by defenders. For offline parsing, `pypykatz` or `impacket`'s `secretsdump` work against the resulting `.dmp` file and are actively maintained.

Happy to help with the Python parser side of things, or with other parts of a security assessment work
